entries.statement: Under a shared confidence gate, a depth-adaptive/early-exit decoder (trained per-layer heads, frozen base) allocates different effective depth and residual error across fair groups (pronoun gender he/she), and this per-group gap WIDENS on real stereotype-violating (anti/conflictive) WinoBias instances vs stereotype-consistent (pro/clean) ones; root cause is group-dependent miscalibration of the exit-confidence signal (per-group temperature scaling collapses the gap), not a fixed group quality ceiling. Tested first on Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct, WinoBias type1, clean->unseen-conflict by occupation.
